summary: Frontend-only Tourlane clone tested at 390/905/1440 widths. All required sections render in correct order with expected counts. All required SVG assets and imgix/ctfassets images load (0 broken). Showcase tabs (Iceland/Thailand/Namibia/Costa Rica) switch title, CTA, and mosaic images correctly. Destination tabs render all regions; Top 10 shows 10 cards. Ambassadors carousel translateX changes on next/prev. Moments/experts/testimonials carousels: prev opacity 0 initially, becomes 1 after next. Newsletter blocks empty submit via required; valid email shows newsletter-success. Both search forms submit without navigation/errors. Mobile at 390px: menu toggle visible, desktop-nav display:none, mobile-menu opens with 5 links, hero placeholder='Where to?', showcase mosaic height=420px with 5/5 images loaded, no horizontal overflow. 0 console errors on any viewport.

issues: Spec expects desktop-nav visible at 905px, but Header uses lg:flex (lg=1280 in tailwind.config.js custom breakpoints), so at 905px the desktop-nav is display:none and mobile-menu-toggle is shown. Either update Header to use md:flex (md=905) or update the spec. Not a functional bug but a spec/breakpoint mismatch.

action_items: Decide breakpoint for desktop nav: change `hidden lg:flex` to `hidden md:flex` on Header desktop-nav (and mirror on mobile-menu-toggle) if desktop-nav should appear at 905px as spec requests; otherwise ignore.
critical_code_review_comments: SearchBar useIsMobile: reading window in initial useState is fine in CRA but would break SSR; acceptable for this CRA app.
Carousel: window.addEventListener('resize') registered but no debounce; fine for scale here.
Header: document.body.style.overflow toggled directly; consider restoring previous value instead of hardcoding ''. Minor.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows pass (1 spec/breakpoint mismatch flagged)

seed_data_creation: none - fully mocked in src/mock.js and src/destinationsData.js
context_for_next_testing_agent: All primary flows verified end-to-end. Custom tailwind breakpoints: sm=600, md=905, lg=1280, xl=1440. Header desktop-nav uses lg:flex; if spec truly requires desktop-nav at 905, patch Header. All CDN/SVG assets load; ambassadors/moments/experts/testimonials carousels & showcase/destination tabs are working. No backend to test.
